info.title: OpenAsy Vulnerabilities API
info.summary: OS package and container image vulnerabilities from SBOMs, ranked by exploitability.
info.description:
Every screen of vulns uses this API, and so can your scripts and CI (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Send SBOMs (Syft JSON, CycloneDX JSON or SPDX JSON) with `VULNS_INGEST_TOKEN`; vulns-agent does this for hosts. Everything else takes `VULNS_ADMIN_TOKEN` until sign-in exists (ADR 0002). Use this release only for testing.

post.summary: Ask a host's agent to scan now
post.description: The agent hears about it on its next heartbeat (every minute) and sends a new SBOM. Images are scanned when CI sends a new SBOM.

Adds or replaces the SBOM of a host or image and matches it. Findings that no longer match are resolved.

```bash
syft ghcr.io/acme/app:1.4.2 -o syft-json | curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VULNS_INGEST_TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- \
  "https://vulns.example.com/api/v1/sboms?kind=image&name=ghcr.io/acme/app:1.4.2&wait=true"
```

The body may be gzipped (`Content-Encoding: gzip`), up to 128 MiB unpacked.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Host name, or image reference such as `ghcr.io/acme/app:1.4.2`. The same kind and name update the same asset.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Answer once matching is done (up to two minutes), so CI can act on the result.

requestBody.description: Syft JSON, CycloneDX JSON or SPDX JSON.

202.description: Stored and queued for matching. Poll the asset for `match.status`.

post.description: Hides a vulnerability on one asset, or on every asset, until it expires. It shows again after the expiry.

put.description:
For installs without internet access (ADR 0015). On a machine that has it, download the archive with `grype db download` (or from the URL in `grype db list`), then upload it:

```bash
curl -sf -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $VULNS_ADMIN_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/zstd' \
  --data-binary @vulnerability-db_v6.tar.zst https://vulns.example.com/api/v1/feed
```

Every asset is matched again afterwards.

post.description: Starts a download from grype.anchore.io, or `VULNS_FEED_URL`. Nothing about this install is sent. Every asset is matched again when the data changed.
Sent by vulns-agent every minute. The answer says whether to scan now.

ingestToken.description: `VULNS_INGEST_TOKEN`: for vulns-agent and CI. It can send SBOMs and heartbeats, nothing else.
